script.title: NEGOTIATING A LEASE RENEWAL
script.story_hook: Sitting down with my landlord to renew the lease.
script.intro_zh: 和房東坐在一起，為續約談判。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, welcome back! Today we're talking lease renewal.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨大家，歡迎回來！今天我們要聊續約談判。
script.outro: That's it for today. Keep listening and see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡。持續練習聽力，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.youtube_title: 【🏠🤝續約談判英文】「房租維持不變」怎麼說？18句教你跟房東成功續約💪｜Lease Renewal English
script.youtube_title_en: “Keep the Same Rent” — Negotiating a Lease Renewal
script.youtube_description:
租約快到期，不知道怎麼跟房東談？這段18句的續約談判對話，教你要求維持房租、用長約換好條件、追問承諾的修繕，最後各讓一步完成續約。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能開口談。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Lease ending soon but scared to talk rent in English? This 18-line renewal conversation teaches you how to ask for the same rent, trade a longer term for better conditions, follow up on promised repairs, and settle on a deal politely. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠續約談判英文｜漲租溝通・長約換條件・跟催修繕｜聽完就會談判｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
租約到期，房東想漲租怎麼辦？
想用英文不傷和氣地談條件嗎？

這一集帶大家走進管理辦公室，跟著房客與房東從漲租的消息、長約的提議、跟催承諾的修繕，一路談到雙方各讓一步、完成續約。

你會聽到：
🏠 談房租：例如「keep the same rent for eighteen months」、「a small increase」。
🔧 跟催修繕：例如「you promised to fix the bathroom fan」、「I'll schedule it this week」。
📝 達成條件：例如「How about fifty off?」、「I'll send the new lease by email Friday」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次續約前，先聽這一集，談出對你有利的條件！
script.thumbnail_action: shaking hands over a lease document

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for meeting me, Mr. Alvarez. My lease ends soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈmitɪŋ mi ˈmɪstər ælvəˈrɛz maɪ lis ɛndz sun/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你抽空見面，Alvarez 先生。我的租約快到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, about that. I was thinking of a small increase.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs əˈbaʊt ðæt aɪ wəz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ə smɔl ɪnˈkris/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，關於這件事，我在想要小漲一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An increase? How much are you thinking about?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ɪnˈkris haʊ mʌtʃ ər ju ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe seventy-five dollars more each month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛbi ˈsɛvənti faɪv ˈdɑlərz mɔr itʃ mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 可能每個月多七十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a lot for us, honestly. We like living here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə lɑt fɔr ʌs ˈɑnəstli wi laɪk ˈlɪvɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 老實說這對我們負擔不小，我們很喜歡住這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it. But the building costs keep going up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt bət ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ kɔsts kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，但大樓的開銷一直往上漲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, could we keep the same rent for eighteen months?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl kʊd wi kip ðə seɪm rɛnt fɔr eˈtin mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以把房租維持不變，一次簽十八個月嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen months? That's actually helpful for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /eˈtin mʌnθs ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ˈhɛlpfəl fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 十八個月？這其實對我也很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! Also, you promised to fix the bathroom fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ju prəˈmɪst tə fɪks ðə ˈbæθrum fæn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！還有，你之前答應要修浴室的排風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I haven't forgotten. I'll schedule it this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt aɪ hævənt fərˈɡɑt aɪl ˈskɛdʒul ɪt ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 對，我沒忘記，這週我就安排來修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we maybe get a month free, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈmeɪbi ɡɛt ə mʌnθ fri tu/
dialogue.zh: 也許可以再給我們一個月免租嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, a free month is tough. How about fifty off?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ə fri mʌnθ ɪz tɔf haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，免一個月有點難，租金扣五十塊怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty off rent, for eighteen months? That works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ɔf rɛnt fɔr eˈtin mʌnθs ðæt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 扣五十塊、為期十八個月？這個可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. I'll send the new lease by email Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl sɛnd ðə nu lis baɪ ˈimel ˈfrɑdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。我星期五會把新租約用電子郵件發出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. We'll sign it right away then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wil saɪn ɪt raɪt əˈweɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 完美，那我們會馬上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice doing business with you. Stay warm this winter!
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈdʊɪŋ ˈbɪznəs wɪð ju steɪ wɔrm ðɪs ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 很高興跟你合作。冬天注意保暖！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too, thanks! We're happy to keep living here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu θæŋks wɪr ˈhæpi tə kip ˈlɪvɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，謝謝！我們很開心能繼續住這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad to hear it. Talk to you Friday, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd tə hɪr ɪt tɔk tə ju ˈfrɑdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 聽你這麼說真好，那我們星期五再聊。
